title: One-sided depth bound under Boolean duality
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\{−1,1\}$. Define $f^*(x)=-f(\mathbf{1}-x)$, with subtraction taken coordinatewise in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The minimum depth of a binary decision tree computing $f^*$ is at most the minimum depth of one computing $f$.
